eventMetadata.context_description: Latest PAGASA forecasts for Metro Manila on June 5 point to a daytime high near 32°C under southwest monsoon influence, with widespread cloud cover, showers, and 70-100% rain chances expected to moderate afternoon heating. These conditions align with early June climatology, where typical maxima range 31-33°C amid high humidity and frequent convection that often prevents stronger warming. Trader consensus favoring 31-32°C reflects current model runs showing limited solar insolation, while the modest probability for 33°C accounts for potential breaks in cloudiness or delayed rainfall. Updated PAGASA briefings and refined numerical weather predictions in the coming days will likely refine the expected peak.
